newsitem.title: USA: ValliCorp sees Q3 EPS below Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: ValliCorp sees Q3 EPS below Q2 results.

text.p: ValliCorp Holdings Inc said it expects its third quarter earnings to be below second quarter earnings of $0.28 a share.
ValliCorp, a bank holding company, said it expects third quarter earnings to be in the range of $0.15 to $0.18 a share. In the 1995 third quarter, the company earned $0.01 a share.
ValliCorp cited one-time costs related to its recent merger with Auburn Bancorp, unusual legal and professional fees and lower than expected average earnings assets for the earnings shortfall.
